name: Paragon
status_note: Open. It closed in April 2025 over finances and reopened Aug 1, 2025 with Kevin Saunderson as partner and resident (RA). Songkick lists events on Oct 23, 24, 30 and 31 and Nov 12, 2026. The official site is paragonbroadway.com; the old paragon.nyc domain now redirects to an unrelated security company, so don't link it.

dress.detail: The official site and the sources checked don't publish a dress code.

cover.value: Ticketed, roughly $20-50. Recent 2026 nights were listed at about $28 all-in.

getting_in.value: Buy tickets in advance on Resident Advisor (the official site's Tickets link goes to RA). Some nights are also sold on DICE.

hours.value: Weekend event nights, mainly Fri and Sat (some Thursday nights). Doors around 9:30-11:30pm. Times vary by event.

subway.value: Myrtle Av (J/M/Z), a few minutes' walk. Time Out places the club at Myrtle-Broadway.

skip_if: You want a sure thing on any night: it's events only, mostly Fri/Sat, and it shut down once already for financial reasons (Apr-Jul 2025).
You want a polished, upscale club: it's a raw, two-level underground dance room.
